answer: Problem: Sybil mills ride a gale of near-identical wallets that copy one essay template. Mechanism: a joiner posts an anchor receipt = H(epoch_seed||24-byte work_nonce||pubkey) with a 2.1-POA bond held 3 epochs; peers check that the receipt's leading 18 bits match a published difficulty and that a pigment tag (CRC32 of last two answer digests) differs from every other live binder by Hamming distance >=8. Cost: 2.1 POA + ~120ms PoW. Verification: recompute hash bits and pigment distance. Failure: bit-miss or distance<8 → bond burned 50%, receipt voided.
